campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 1, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered a resolution authorizing an agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority to accept low-carbon transportation and operations program funding for a transit reliability improvement and performance systems project. The agenda also referenced pothole damage claims processes.
keyTopics: Resolution to authorize a low-carbon transportation and operations program fund agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority for a transit reliability improvement and performance systems project
Pothole damage claims process

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business including meeting minutes, vendor payments, and a conflict of interest code update, along with final map approvals for two residential lot splits. The Council also held public hearings on two appeals of Planning Commission decisions involving properties on 6th Street and Oak Place, and discussed law enforcement service options ahead of upcoming town hall meetings.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission approval for a single-family residence and ADU with a setback variance at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision at 14486 Oak Place
Law enforcement service options for the city, ahead of September 19 and 30 town halls
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 8, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered several routine budget and contract items, including updated city employee pay schedules and additional funding for an electrical maintenance contractor. The Council also took up renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street, restructuring the Volunteer Awards Committee, a citizen initiative on zoning impacts, and direction on the upcoming CalCities conference resolution package and the Environmental Commission's future.
keyTopics: Renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Revised Fiscal Year 2026/27 pay schedules for city employee groups
Amendment No. 4 adding $250,000 to Bear Electrical Solutions' maintenance contract
Disbanding the joint Los Altos-Los Altos Hills Volunteer Awards Committee to form a Los Altos-only committee
Citizen initiative presentation on potential impacts to zoning

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine administrative business at this meeting, including approval of prior meeting minutes and a monthly financial report. The Council also considered several contract-related items, including amendments to existing agreements and new professional services agreements with outside vendors.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 Closed Session and regular Town Council meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026
A second amendment to an existing town agreement
A first amendment to a Heating Ventilation and Air (HVAC-related) agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town Manager to execute

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 16, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed upcoming City Council agendas for late September 2026 and the public record log for early September. The committee also considered approvals for several council district-sponsored special events involving city funds and donated materials, plus a proposed policy on self-checkout safety standards for grocery and drug stores.
keyTopics: Review of the September 22 and September 29, 2026 City Council draft/final agendas, including adding items and setting time-certain slots
Public record log covering September 3-10, 2026
Free use of the Janet Gray Hayes Rotunda on November 19, 2026 for a Santa Clara County Association of Realtors event sponsored by Council District 9
Retroactive approval of the Santos Family Car Show (Council District 4) and various Council District 5 events as city-sponsored special events
Proposed self-checkout safety standards for grocery and drug retail stores, brought by Councilmembers Candelas and Cohen

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — September 14, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee met to open the floor for public comments, take part in a team-building exercise, and discuss its proposed work plan for the upcoming 2026-27 fiscal year. Committee members and staff also shared updates and reports at the meeting.
keyTopics: Public oral communications on non-agenda items
Team Builder exercise for committee members
Discussion of the Fiscal Year 2026-27 Youth Advisory Committee Work Plan
Committee and staff comments, questions, and reports

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 15, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: The Sunnyvale City Council considered several routine budget and contract items, including a new sewer-cleaning vehicle purchase, a street slurry seal contract, and management-level pay raises. The Council also took up updates to its own meeting policies and procedures, a resolution renaming a water treatment facility, and a required hearing on tax-exempt bonds for a new affordable housing project.
keyTopics: Contract for a Vac-Con combination jet/vacuum sewer cleaner vehicle ($793,417.50)
Homestead Road slurry seal paving contract; all bids rejected for the Plaza Del Sol Phase II project
Salary increases for management, confidential, and unclassified management employee pay categories
Renaming the Donald M. Somers Water Pollution Control Plant to the Sunnyvale Donald M. Somers Clean Water Facility
TEFRA hearing and resolution on tax-exempt bonds for a 123-unit affordable rental housing project at 245 W. Weddell Drive

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met to discuss potential litigation and a real property negotiation with the Cupertino Union School District over land at 10480 Finch Avenue, recognized Cupertino High School students for their national business competition achievements, and worked through a routine consent calendar covering city finances, policy updates, and committee appointments. The Council also considered its response to a county Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims processes.
keyTopics: Closed session on anticipated litigation and real property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue with Cupertino Union School District
Recognition of Cupertino High School students for the 2026 FBLA National Leadership Conference
Postponement of a proposed ordinance revising definitions of 'attic,' 'garages,' and 'square footage' in the Municipal Code
Adoption of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) City Council Policy and an Audit Committee duties ordinance update
Response to the Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on improving pothole damage claims processes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: Santa Clara's City Council held a special meeting that began with interviews to fill two seats on the Civil Service Commission, followed by a joint meeting with the Stadium Authority Board. Business items included citywide janitorial services, a historic preservation agreement for a Jackson Street property, and review of annual workplans for various city boards and commissions.
keyTopics: Interviews and appointment of two applicants to the Civil Service Commission
Recognition of outgoing commissioners from several city boards and commissions
Contract amendment negotiations for citywide janitorial services with Impec Group, Inc.
Historic Preservation Agreement (Mills Act Contract) for 1261 Jackson Street
Review and approval of FY 2026-2027 annual workplans for city boards, commissions, and committees

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered funding plans for federal community development grants, a review of the city's red light camera traffic safety program, and an assessment of the physical condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also took up financial actions related to the former Redevelopment Agency's successor agency, including a bond refunding measure.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan funding
Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program presentation and authorization
Condition assessment of the Milpitas Community Center
Resolution actions for the Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency
Sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Planning & Transportation Commission — September 9, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Planning & Transportation Commission considered a proposed ordinance amending the municipal code to address City Council direction on allowing accessory dwelling units (ADUs) to be sold separately from the primary home. The Commission also received a Director's Report, reviewed its meeting schedule and assignments, and was asked to approve draft minutes from its August 12, 2026 meeting.
keyTopics: Proposed ordinance amending Municipal Code Titles 18 and 21 regarding separate sale of accessory dwelling units (ADUs)
Director's Report covering department updates
Review of Commission meeting schedule and member assignments
Approval of draft summary minutes from the August 12, 2026 meeting
